identitySignals: Name matches a registered nonprofit: 'Social Good Fund Inc' (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, EIN 46-1323531), located in Richmond, CA, matching the agenda location

Organization's own site describes Social Good Fund as a California nonprofit that provides fiscal sponsorship for community projects, matching OUSD's after-school and summer program contracts run through sponsored projects
BAY-Peace (named in an earlier OUSD agreement title for the same vendor) states on its own site that it is 'a fiscally sponsored project of Social Good Fund'
West Oakland Walk, an Oakland project, is fiscally sponsored by Social Good Fund, consistent with the West Oakland Middle School agreement
research.notes: Agenda titles also reference BAY-Peace, a youth project fiscally sponsored by Social Good Fund; the vendor of record is the fiscal sponsor. Phone is shown as 510-621-7223 on the contact page. California Secretary of State entity number and SAM.gov UEI were not looked up.

profile.summary: Social Good Fund is a California nonprofit corporation and registered 501(c)(3) organization based in Richmond, California. It acts as a fiscal sponsor, which means it provides legal and financial infrastructure so community, arts, environmental and other social-benefit projects can receive tax-deductible donations without forming their own nonprofit.
